{{2015–16 Big West men's basketball standings}}
The '''2015–16 Cal Poly Mustangs men's basketball team''' represented the [[California Polytechnic State University]] in the [[2015–16 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. They were led by seventh year head coach [[Joe Callero]] and played their home games at [[Mott Athletic Center]]. They were members of the [[Big West Conference]]. They finished the season 10–20, 4–12 in Big West play to finish in eighth place. They lost in the quarterfinals of the [[2016 Big West Conference men's basketball tournament|Big West tournament]] to [[2015–16 UC Irvine Anteaters men's basketball team|UC Irvine]].

==Previous season==
The Mustangs finished 13–16, 6–10 in Big West play to finish in seventh place. They lost in the first round of the [[2015 Big West Conference men's basketball tournament|Big West tournament]] where they lost to UC Santa Barbara.
